tweet.text:
Same one line prompt, temperature 0, cap 2000 this morning: 1945, 2000, 2000 thinking tokens. Two of three runs came back empty, billed in full, finish stop.

Same prompt tonight, cap 8000: 2030, 3158, 2421. Natural stops. Real answers. None got near the cap.

So the 2000 cap was sitting inside the natural draw range, slicing runs mid-thought and looking exactly like a model failure. Raising it above the distribution made the empties disappear.

Still unknown whether the draw width scales with task size. A tagline only draws 2k to 3.2k.
